title_en: You Are One of a Kind
page_text_ocr_zh:
“孩子，谢谢你的倾听。”妈妈说。“我们希望你都能记在心里。”
爸爸挤了挤眼，轻声说，“我们知道全记下有点多。”
丹尼向后翻了个筋斗，俏皮地冲他们微笑。
马上就要带着刚学到的东西去闯世界了，他很兴奋。“等等我！”
他冲他的朋友们喊道。
page_text_en:
"Child, thank you for listening," Mom said. "We hope you can all remember it in your heart."
Dad squinted his eyes and whispered, "We know it's a bit much to remember everything."
Danny flipped backward, smiling playfully at them.
"I'm about to go out into the world with everything I've just learned," he said excitedly. "Wait for me!"
He shouted to his friends.
summary_zh: 丹尼在父母的鼓励下，准备带着新学到的知识去探索世界，他兴奋地向朋友们喊话，画面中几条小鱼在水下游动，象征着即将开始的冒险。

title_en: You Are One of a Kind
page_text_ocr_zh:
就在丹尼要游走的时候，
他转身对父母说，
“我会记住的。”
妈妈在他额头上亲了一下，说：
“在这个世界上，你是独一无二的。”
page_text_en:
Just as Danny was about to swim away,
he turned to his parents and said,
"I'll remember."
His mother kissed him on the forehead and said:
"In this world, you are one of a kind."
summary_zh: 丹尼准备离开时，转身向父母承诺会记住所学，母亲亲吻他的额头并告诉他他是独一无二的，传递了爱与肯定的情感。

title_en: You Are One of a Kind

title_en: You Are One of a Kind
page_text_ocr_zh:
小鱼丹尼即将长大，爸爸妈妈把幸福人生的智慧分享给他，并告诉他：“在这个大千世界里，你是独一无二的。”带着父母分享给他的智慧财富，小丹尼开始了自己的探索，当他见识了这个世界的色彩斑斓后，妈妈告诉他：“孩子，生命是个漫长的旅程，你要勇敢做自己。”

Little fish Danny is about to grow up. His parents share the wisdom of a happy life with him and tell him: "In this vast world, you are one of a kind." With the wisdom his parents have shared, little Danny begins his own exploration. After experiencing the colorful wonders of the world, his mother tells him: "Child, life is a long journey. You must dare to be yourself."
